{{t|Flying}}-types (Elite Four) }} {{Character Infobox/Anime |color={{flying color light}} |series=''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]'' |debut=''[[HZ018|Flying Pikachu, Rising Higher and Higher!]]'' |enva=N/A |jpva=Kosuke Toriumi }} |} '''Larry''' (Japanese: '''アオキ''' ''Aoki'') is a member of both [[Elite Four]] of the [[Paldea]] [[region]], as well as the [[Gym Leader]] of [[Medali]]'s [[Gym]], known officially as the [[Medali Gym]]. He [[Type expert|specializes]] in {{type|Normal}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} as a Gym Leader and {{type|Flying}} Pokémon as an Elite Four member. ==In animation== ===History=== Larry debuted in ''[[HZ018|Flying Pikachu, Rising Higher and Higher!]]''. He was seen in a flashback, eating at the [[Treasure Eatery]] while [[Friede]] met with [[Lucca]] there. In ''[[HZ046|Welcome to Naranja Academy!]]'', Larry appeared with the other members of the [[Elite Four]] watching [[Liko]]'s battle against [[Ann]] at [[Naranja Academy]]. In ''[[HZ055|Showdown! The Paldea Elite Four]]'', Larry battled [[Coral]] and [[Kofu]] as part of the [[Elite Four Tag Battle]], only for Coral to have her {{p|Glalie}} use {{m|Self-Destruct}}, knocking out all of their Pokémon and leaving Larry the winner by default. In ''[[HZ057|The Terapagos I Don't Know]]'', Larry was assigned as [[Dot]]'s next challenge for the [[Tera Training]] course. In the [[HZ058|next episode]], Larry appeared during the reopening of the new menu at [[Anything Eatery]]. After the meal, he left without attracting much attention, but was noticed by Dot when he left. In ''[[HZ059|Dance, Quaxly! The Blue Medali Step!]]'', Larry was Dot's opponent for her second Terastal battle, where he used both his {{p|Staraptor}} and {{p|Dudunsparce}} against Dot's {{TP|Dot|Quaxly}} and {{TP|Dot|Tinkatink}}. Even after Dot's Quaxly evolved into {{TP|Dot|Quaxwell}} and put up a great fight by {{Tera}}stallizing, Larry was still able to win by Terastallizing his Staraptor in turn. Despite her loss, Larry still approved Dot for her opportunistic use of Terastallization. In ''[[HZ066|Infiltrating the System! Naranja Academy in Danger!]]'', Larry was seen talking with Geeta and Ryme during the [[Course Students Battle Tournament]]. Larry appeared again in ''[[HZ079|Over the Top!]]'' when the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] arrived at the {{pal|Pokémon League}} asking for permission to go to [[Area Zero]]. Later, he watched Liko, [[Roy]], and Dot's battle against [[Geeta]] along with the Elite Four members present. ===Character=== Larry is a serious, brooding man who works for Paldea's [[Pokémon League]] under [[Geeta]], who assigned him the roles of both a Gym Leader and Elite Four member. He's also quite straightfoward and cynical, telling an irritated [[Coral]] that her personal rules don't apply to society following their [[Elite Four Tag Battle]]. Outside of his Pokémon League duties, he is known for his fixation with food, and regularly visits the Treasure Eatery of Medali, as well as venturing to other restaurants to check their cuisine, such as the Anything Eatery. He also enjoys the simplicities of life, remarking that Anything Eatery's simple noodles are far better than their most eccentric options. ===Pokémon=== Similar to the games, Larry uses two completely different teams of Pokémon, one team for challenges as a Gym Leader and another for battles as an Elite Four member.
